config.edgeworth_quadrature: 64-node Gauss-Hermite against clipped and renormalized diagonal Edgeworth correction, with the pure Gaussian raw-moment part evaluated exactly as a control variate.
config.offdiagonal_covariance_closure: nonzero-mean Gaussian GL16 Price-identity bivariate ReLU closure ported from estimator.py/gaussian_sum_pretest.py; Edgeworth variances replace only the diagonal.

cost_accounting.summary: One route is about 1.1e9 dense covariance multiply-adds plus O(32*16*256^2) GL16 pair-density evaluations and at most two extra 32*256^2 cumulant matvecs, i.e. low-1e9-class before implementation constants.

recommended_next_action: Do not scorer-engineer this diagonal one-loop kappa4 route. The layer-8 kappa4 validation is essentially gone (corr=-0.013, scale=0.004), so the failure localizes to independence/diagonal cumulant propagation; only an oracle empirical-cumulant closure check or a joint-kappa4 design would be a meaningful next gate.
